project: PRD-259 Skins in Studio — Wave 1: the skin format and validator, private skins (tables, ONE migration, import, assets, installed), the Style dropdown with the skin engine, --radius and dark: fixed globally (one branch, one PR, one CI run)
description: PRD-259 (docs/PRDS/PRD-259-SKINS-IN-STUDIO.md) Wave 1: S-001, S-002, S-003, S-009, S-004 (split a/b), S-010 (split a/b), in dependency order. Wave 2 (S-005 Marketplace routes, S-006 the Skins tab, S-007 Auto in chat, S-008 the colour sweep, S-011 docs) is scripts/ralph/prd-259w2.json. Diff base for every check: `bash scripts/ralph/acceptance-prd259w1.sh --print-base`. THIS WAVE HAS ONE MIGRATION (S-002).
decisions: D1 (§10.1, Gerard 14 Oct): mascot rights settled, Auto ships in Studio — Wave 2 (S-007); nothing in this wave.
D2 (§10.2): Skins is its own top-level Marketplace tab — Wave 2 (S-006); 'Browse skins' in the dropdown arrives with it.
D3 (§10.3): --radius is fixed globally — S-009 here, a visible change named in the PR.
D4 (§10.4): dark: is fixed globally — darkMode ['class', '.dark'] plus the audit of every use, S-010a/S-010b here.
D5 (§10.5): the automatos-play PRs merge later; Play's lib/looks and lib/mascot are READ-ONLY references, re-implemented in the core's style, never imported or edited.
D6 (§10.6, OPEN): a workspace default skin is Gerard's open question — NOT built; install is per workspace, the active choice per browser; nothing may make a later default harder.

K1 (kit, 14 Oct): the server must set the base class without a database call, so the skin's base rides in a second cookie, automatos-skin-base ('studio' | 'classic'), beside automatos-style = 'skin:<id>' (the PRD's cookie value is kept).

K2 (kit): an asset route needs the bearer token, which a CSS url() or cannot send (SaaS), so fonts load through the FontFace API from bytes fetched via apiClient's seam (the BrandKitFonts / fetchBrandFileObjectUrl precedent) and previews through object URLs; the generated CSS names Studio-made family names, never a url().

K3 (kit): private imports are stored under skins/_workspace/{workspace_id}/{slug}/{version}/ so two workspaces importing the same slug never share or overwrite files; Marketplace skins keep the PRD's skins/{slug}/{version}/.
K4 (kit): a light-only skin locks Light the way §4 locks Dark for a dark-only one (the PRD allows either tone alone).

K5 (kit): contrast pairs are checked on the skin's own values; setting one side of a pair requires the other (PAIR_INCOMPLETE), because Classic's own primary pair is 3.31:1 and a check against base values would fail every Classic-based skin.
One PR per wave: story commits end ' [skip ci]'; the runner opens the draft PR once when the build is COMPLETE; ONE CI run. Cut from origin/main; never merge anything into the branch.
ownerTest: TESTER: build the local stack from this branch's tip (one Docker build at a time); `alembic upgrade head` on the local database (one new revision, prd259_skins; two new tables; no existing table changed).

TESTER: make a skin with the Skin Kit (automatos-play), then in Studio: Style → Add a skin… → it applies at once; reload → no flash of Studio first; a dark-only skin greys out Light and leaving it restores the old tone; a broken or uninstalled skin falls back to its base with the quiet notice; a second workspace never sees the skin.

TESTER: before/after screenshots for --radius (Classic and Studio, light and dark: card, dialog, button, input) and for the dark: audit (the chat's sheet, text and markdown artifacts, the workflow and memory widgets in Classic Dark and Studio Dark), added to the PR body.

Gerard: review the 'blocked by the code-shape ratchet' rows of docs/PRDS/PRD-259-DARK-VARIANT-AUDIT.md and the kit decisions K1–K5; answer §10.6 (a workspace default skin) before Wave 2 if it should ride there.

userStories.title: The skin format automatos-skin/v1: one rule set in the frontend and the backend, proven identical; GET /api/skins/schema
userStories.description: As Studio (and the Skin Kit that syncs from it), I want one validator for skin.json, the same in frontend/lib/skins/ and orchestrator/services/skins/, so a skin is data that is checked the same way everywhere and can never carry code or an unreadable colour pair (PRD-259 §3).
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/lib/skins/schema.ts exports SKIN_SCHEMA_ID = 'automatos-skin/v1'; ALLOWED_TOKENS = exactly these 47 names, in this order: background, foreground, card, card-foreground, popover, popover-foreground, primary, primary-foreground, secondary, secondary-foreground, muted, muted-foreground, accent, accent-foreground, destructive, destructive-foreground, border, input, ring, success, success-foreground, warning, warning-foreground, info, info-foreground, agent, agent-foreground, chart-1, chart-2, chart-3, chart-4, chart-5, stage-1, stage-2, stage-3, stage-4, stage-5, stage-6, stage-7, stage-8, stage-9, olive, warn-ink, on-strong, border-2, accent-2, navy; DERIVED_ALIASES = ['paper','bg-1','bg-2','fg','fg-2','fg-3'] (setting one is the error DERIVED_TOKEN); CONTRAST_PAIRS = foreground/background, card-foreground/card, popover-foreground/popover, primary-foreground/primary, secondary-foreground/secondary, muted-foreground/background, muted-foreground/card, accent-foreground/accent, destructive-foreground/destructive, success-foreground/success, warning-foreground/warning, info-foreground/info, agent-foreground/agent (each >= 4.5:1), ring/background (>= 3:1); SHIPPED_FONTS = ['geist','geist-mono','newsreader'] (the faces app/layout.tsx loads); MASCOT_STATES (the 12 of Play's lib/mascot/types.ts: hello, idle, listening, thinking, working, searching, reading, celebrate, oops, sleeping, lost, loading), MASCOT_SHELLS (bronze, gold, silver, cobalt), MASCOT_LIGHTS (mint, amber, ice, rose); SKIN_ID_PATTERN (a UUID). → DONE — frontend/lib/skins/schema.ts (47 ALLOWED_TOKENS in order, DERIVED_ALIASES, 14 CONTRAST_PAIRS, SHIPPED_FONTS, MASCOT_STATES/SHELLS/LIGHTS, SKIN_ID_PATTERN); commit c860243f8

frontend/lib/skins/validate.ts exports validateSkin(input: unknown) → {ok: true, skin} | {ok: false, errors: {code, path, message}[]}, with the codes SCHEMA, UNKNOWN_FIELD, UNKNOWN_TOKEN, DERIVED_TOKEN, BAD_VALUE, TONES_MISMATCH, PAIR_INCOMPLETE, CONTRAST, BAD_FONT, BAD_SHAPE, BAD_MASCOT, BAD_TEXT. Fields: schema, slug (kebab-case, 1-64), name (1-40 code points), version (semver), author, description (<= 280), licence, base ('studio' | 'classic'), tones (['light','dark'] or one alone; tokens.light is required exactly when 'light' is in tones, tokens.dark exactly when 'dark' is, else TONES_MISMATCH), tokens, fonts {sans, serif, mono} (each a SHIPPED_FONTS key or a path matching ^assets/fonts/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}\.woff2$), shape {radius: integer 0-24, glow: integer 0-40}, mascot {mode: 'off'|'auto'|'custom', shell?, light?}, preview ('assets/preview.png'). Any other field at any level is UNKNOWN_FIELD. → DONE — frontend/lib/skins/validate.ts + tokens.ts + fields.ts, all 12 codes; judgement calls: required = schema, slug, name, version, base, tones, tokens; author/description/licence/fonts/shape/mascot/preview optional, each fonts slot optional; a bad slug/version/base/preview/tones is SCHEMA; author and licence capped at 80 code points; commit c860243f8

Values: a token is 'H S% L%' (H 0-360, S and L 0-100, at most 2 decimals) or '#rrggbb', both normalised by formatTriplet(h, s, l) (frontend/lib/skins/color.ts) to the triplet form; anything else is BAD_VALUE. Free text (name, description, author, licence) refuses '<', '>', '://', 'url(' and control characters (BAD_TEXT). Nothing in a skin is ever CSS, JavaScript, SVG, HTML or a URL. → DONE — frontend/lib/skins/color.ts (formatTriplet, normaliseColor, hslToRgb); free text also refuses 'javascript:' (case-insensitive) so the corpus's javascript: author is BAD_TEXT; commit c860243f8

Contrast, per tone in tones (frontend/lib/skins/contrast.ts: WCAG 2.x relative luminance from HSL via sRGB, ported from Play's lib/looks/contrast.ts): a pair is checked when the skin sets either side of it; setting one side without the other is PAIR_INCOMPLETE; a ratio under its floor is CONTRAST, the message naming both tokens, the tone and the ratio to 2 decimals (Classic's own primary pair is 3.31:1, so the check cannot lean on base values: decision K5). → DONE — frontend/lib/skins/contrast.ts (HSL→sRGB→WCAG); PAIR_INCOMPLETE/CONTRAST in tokens.ts; message names both tokens, the tone, ratio.toFixed(2); measured: Studio accent 4.57, Classic primary 3.31; commit c860243f8

orchestrator/services/skins/ (a new package: __init__.py, schema.py, validate.py, contrast.py) implements the same rules with the same codes, in plain Python or Pydantic (no new dependency); services.skins.schema.schema_document() returns {schema, allowedTokens, derivedAliases, contrastPairs, shippedFonts, mascot, shape, text} built from the module's constants. → DONE — orchestrator/services/skins/{__init__,schema,color,contrast,fields,tokens,validate}.py, stdlib only, same codes; schema_document() in schema.py; commit c860243f8

ONE shared case corpus, orchestrator/tests/fixtures/skins/cases.json: {allowedTokens, contrastPairs, cases: [{name, skin, expect: {ok, codes}}]} with at least 25 cases: Studio's own light and dark tokens from app/globals.css written as a skin (valid: they pass every pair, measured 14 Oct), a dark-only skin, a '#rrggbb' skin, at least one case per error code, and the injection attempts '0 0% 0%; } body{display:none', 'url(https://x)', '</style><script>', a 'javascript:' author. orchestrator/tests/test_prd259_skin_validator.py and frontend/lib/skins/__tests__/validator-parity.test.ts each run EVERY case (the vitest reads ../orchestrator/tests/fixtures/skins/cases.json: CI checks out the whole repo) and assert the verdict and the codes, and assert their own ALLOWED_TOKENS and CONTRAST_PAIRS equal the corpus lists. → DONE — orchestrator/tests/fixtures/skins/cases.json: 64 cases (12 valid incl. Studio light+dark from globals.css, dark-only, #rrggbb; every code; the 4 injection attempts), one case per line (86 lines, under the 800 new-file cap); test_prd259_skin_validator.py (parametrised over every case + list equality) and frontend/lib/skins/__tests__/validator-parity.test.ts (reads ../orchestrator/tests/fixtures/skins/cases.json); the Python validator was checked against all 64 locally with a stdlib script, the vitest runs in CI; commit c860243f8

GET /api/skins/schema in a NEW orchestrator/api/marketplace_skins.py (the PRD's router file; registered in orchestrator/main.py beside marketplace_plugins_router), authenticated with get_request_context_hybrid, a plain def, returns schema_document(); orchestrator/tests/test_prd259_skin_schema_route.py asserts the payload (dependency-override pattern of the existing route tests). → DONE — orchestrator/api/marketplace_skins.py (prefix /api/skins, plain def get_skin_schema, Depends(get_request_context_hybrid)), registered in main.py after marketplace_plugins_router; orchestrator/tests/test_prd259_skin_schema_route.py (payload, 401 without a caller, plain def + dependency, main.py registration); commit c860243f8

orchestrator/reports/route-manifest.json gains {"method": "GET", "path": "/api/skins/schema"} in sorted position and route_count + 1, edited by hand (scripts/dump_routes.py needs the app's dependencies, which this machine lacks). → DONE — route-manifest.json: GET /api/skins/schema after /api/sites/{site_id}/settings, route_count 914 → 915, edited by hand (sorted by path, method); commit c860243f8

Code shape on every touched line (functions <= 50 code lines, nesting <= 4, new files <= 800 lines, aim 200-400); python3 -m py_compile clean; cd frontend && node scripts/check-changed-lines-eslint.js origin/main → 0 errors. → DONE — check_changed_code_shape.py --base origin/main 0 errors; check-changed-lines-eslint.js origin/main 0 errors; py_compile clean; hierarchy gate OK; acceptance --no-ci S-001 checks PASS; commit c860243f8
userStories.notes: Port the colour maths from Play (read-only reference: /Users/gkavanagh/Development/Automatos-AI-Platform/.worktrees/automatos-play/ralph+play-pages-a/lib/looks/{contrast,validate,types}.ts; the same files are staged at /Users/gkavanagh/Development/Automatos-AI-Platform/automatos-ai/scripts/ralph/prd259-spec/play-looks-ref/). Play works in #rrggbb; Studio's tokens are HSL triplets consumed as hsl(var(--x)), so convert HSL→sRGB first. Measured 14 Oct on origin/main's globals.css: Studio light/dark pass all 14 pairs (accent 4.57); Classic fails primary (3.31), accent, destructive, success, info, agent — a Classic-based skin that sets those must fix them. zod 3.25 is already a frontend dependency if you want it.

userStories.title: Private skins: the package reader, POST /api/skins/import, GET /api/skins/{id}/assets/{path}, GET /api/skins/installed
userStories.description: As a developer using the Skin Kit, I want to load a .autoskin file into my workspace only, installed at once, and have its assets served safely, so I can see my skin in Studio without a review (PRD-259 §4, §5; the developer loop).
acceptanceCriteria: orchestrator/services/skins/package.py read_package(data: bytes) → the validated skin plus a manifest {path: {type, size, sha256}}. A zip only. Refused, each with a clear message and a code: bigger than SKIN_MAX_PACKAGE_MB; any member other than skin.json, assets/preview.png, assets/fonts/<name>.woff2, assets/mascot/<state>.(webm|mp4|png) for the 12 MASCOT_STATES; an absolute path, '..', a backslash, a duplicate name, a symlink (external_attr S_IFLNK); total uncompressed size over the cap (checked from infolist before any read, and counted while reading); a font that is not woff2 by its bytes (signature wOF2; reuse modules/documents/brand_fonts.check_woff2 for the structure if .importlinter allows services → modules.documents, else the same checks) or over SKIN_MAX_FONT_KB; mascot media not webm (1A 45 DF A3) / mp4 ('ftyp' at offset 4) / png (89 50 4E 47) by bytes, or over SKIN_MAX_MASCOT_MB in total; a preview that is not PNG or over SKIN_MAX_PREVIEW_KB; a file skin.json does not name, or a file it names that is missing; 'custom' mascot without all 12 states in all three formats. skin.json goes through S-001's validator. → DONE — services/skins/package.py read_package (zip only: PK signature, end record read BEFORE zipfile parses it so a flood of tiny entries is refused as TOO_MANY_FILES, zip64 refused; symlink, absolute/'..'/backslash/drive/control-char paths, duplicates, encrypted members, members outside the allow-list; declared uncompressed total from infolist, every read capped at what is left + 1; woff2 by bytes + brand_fonts.check_woff2 (importlinter's root is `modules`, so services may import it), mascot webm/mp4/png sniffed, shared mascot cap, PNG preview; undeclared, missing and incomplete-mascot files; skin.json through validate_skin) and services/skins/assets.py (paths, caps, sniffing, ASSET_TYPES); 22 package codes in PACKAGE_ERROR_CODES; judgement call: the folder entries a zip tool writes (assets/, assets/fonts/, assets/mascot/) are skipped, any other folder entry is NOT_ALLOWED; commit c443a43cb

POST /api/skins/import (multipart field `file`): authenticated (get_request_context_hybrid) and authorised with the workspace-permission dependency the existing workspace upload routes use (re-verify by grep; the brand-kit logo upload is one); the read is capped at SKIN_MAX_PACKAGE_MB, and orchestrator/main.py's PATH_BODY_LIMITS gains the route at that cap + 512 KB (the transport default MAX_BODY_SIZE is 10 MB and would 413 a valid 15 MB package). It stores the files under the private prefix, upserts THIS workspace's private marketplace_skins row (owner_type 'workspace', status 'approved', workspace_id from the request context; the same slug again replaces its content and version) and an active skin_installations row, and returns the installed-skin payload. 400 carries the validator's codes and messages; 413 over the cap. No other workspace can ever see the row. → DONE — api/marketplace_skins.py import_skin: plain def, get_request_context_hybrid + require_workspace_permission('workspace:manage') (the brand-kit logo upload's gate); upload read to SKIN_MAX_PACKAGE_MB + 1 byte (413 PACKAGE_TOO_LARGE, 400 {message, errors} with the codes); main.py PATH_BODY_LIMITS gains SKIN_IMPORT_ROUTE at package_max_bytes() + 512 KB; services/skins/records.py save_private_import upserts this workspace's private row (owner_type workspace, approved, workspace_id from ctx; same slug replaces content and version, row locked FOR UPDATE) and the active installation, then writes the files under skins/_workspace/{ws}/{slug}/{version}/ before the commit (review fix: a refused or failed import writes nothing and commits nothing; a concurrent first import is a 409), then removes the files the previous import named and the new one doesn't; returns the installed-skin payload; commit c443a43cb

GET /api/skins/installed: this workspace's active installations (uninstalled_at IS NULL) joined to their skins, filtered by the request context's workspace_id: [{id, slug, name, version, base, tones, tokens, fonts, shape, mascot, preview, ownerType}]. A plain def. → DONE — GET /api/skins/installed (plain def): records.list_installed joins active installations (uninstalled_at IS NULL) of ctx.workspace_id to their skins, and a private skin only when it is this workspace's own (a forged installation never shows another workspace's skin); payload {id, slug, name, version, base, tones, tokens, fonts, shape, mascot, preview, ownerType}; commit c443a43cb

GET /api/skins/{skin_id}/assets/{asset_path:path}: serves a file only when asset_path is a key of that skin's stored manifest AND the skin is visible to the caller's workspace (its own private skin, or a skin installed in it); anything else is 404, never 403 (no existence leak across workspaces). Content-Type is the manifest's checked type; headers X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Cache-Control: private, max-age=<SKIN_ASSET_CACHE_SECONDS>, immutable (the client adds ?v=<version>). → DONE — GET /api/skins/{skin_id}/assets/{asset_path:path} (plain def): records.visible_skin (own private skin, or a Marketplace skin with an active installation here); 404 'Skin asset not found.' for a malformed or unknown id, another workspace's skin, a path not in the stored manifest, a type outside ASSET_TYPES, or a storage read failure (logged); Content-Type = the manifest's checked type; X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Cache-Control: private, max-age=SKIN_ASSET_CACHE_SECONDS, immutable. userStories.title: The skin engine: CSS generated from validated numbers only, scoped to outrank .studio and .studio.dark; derived aliases; fonts through FontFace; the pre-paint script and its cache
userStories.description: As Studio, I want to turn a validated skin into one stylesheet that only Studio writes, applied before first paint, so a skin can change colours, fonts and shape but can never inject anything (PRD-259 §4).
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/lib/skins/css.ts exports skinToCss(skin, skinId): skinId must match SKIN_ID_PATTERN or it throws; the light block is `html[data-skin="<id>"]{…}` from tokens.light, the dark block `html.dark[data-skin="<id>"]{…}` from tokens.dark; every token value is re-parsed to numbers and written by formatTriplet(h, s, l); --radius by formatPx(shape.radius); --skin-glow from shape.glow; the pre-wrapped Studio aliases are written wrapped as globals.css does: --border-2: hsl(<t>), --navy: hsl(<t>), --accent-2: hsl(<t> / 0.10) in the light block and / 0.14 in the dark one; olive, warn-ink, on-strong stay raw triplets.

Derived aliases from the skin's own tokens (never set by a skin): --paper ← card, --bg-1 ← background, --bg-2 ← secondary, --fg ← foreground, --fg-2 ← muted-foreground, all as hsl(<t>), and --fg-3: hsl(<muted-foreground> / FG3_ALPHA) with FG3_ALPHA = 0.75 a named constant; an alias whose source the skin does not set is not emitted.

Specificity: the light selector (0,1,1) outranks .studio and :root (0,1,0); the dark selector (0,2,1) outranks .studio.dark (0,2,0) and .dark. Tailwind 3 compiles @layer base to plain CSS (no native cascade layers), so specificity decides; a test asserts the exact selectors.

frontend/lib/skins/__tests__/css.test.ts has a test titled 'never interpolates a raw string': a skin object that bypassed the validator, with '0 0% 0%; } body{display:none', 'url(https://evil)', '</style><script>', a radius of '8px;}' and an id of 'x"]{}', makes skinToCss throw, and no output ever contains 'url(', '<', '@', '\\' or a brace inside a value; plus a golden test for Studio-as-skin (the S-001 corpus case) and the derived aliases.
css.ts exports SKIN_CSS_GRAMMAR, a regex every skinToCss output matches and that refuses 'url(', '@', '\\', '<' and nested braces; a test runs it over the golden output and the attack strings.

Fonts: frontend/lib/skins/fonts.ts registers a skin's woff2 files with the FontFace API from bytes fetched through apiClient's seam: apiFileUrl(apiClient.getBaseUrl(), path) + apiClient.getAuthHeaders() → object URL, the fetchBrandFileObjectUrl pattern of components/documents/blocks/api.ts (reuse or extract it into a shared helper; do not copy it). Families are Studio-generated names skin-<id>-sans|serif|mono; shipped keys map to Studio's own variables (--font-geist-sans, --font-geist-mono, --font-newsreader, set by next/font in app/layout.tsx), and the generated CSS sets those variables on html[data-skin] (no @font-face url(): an asset needs the bearer token, decision K2). A face the browser refuses leaves the base font (logged, not thrown). Unit test with a mocked FontFace and apiClient.

frontend/lib/skins/prepaint.ts exports SKIN_PREPAINT_SCRIPT, a constant string built at module load from constants only (the LOOK_PREPAINT_SCRIPT pattern of Play's lib/looks/prepaint.ts): it reads document.documentElement's data-skin and the cache localStorage['automatos-skin-css'] = {id, version, css}, and creates <style id="automatos-skin"> with textContent = css ONLY when cache.id equals data-skin and css matches SKIN_CSS_GRAMMAR; otherwise it does nothing (the base style shows; the provider repairs after hydration). Never innerHTML; storage access in try/catch. frontend/lib/skins/cache.ts reads and writes that entry (try/catch).

frontend/lib/skins/__tests__/prepaint.test.ts runs the script string in jsdom: a valid cache → the style element holds exactly the cached css; a cache for another id → nothing; a cached css containing 'url(' → nothing; localStorage throwing → nothing and no exception.
Port, don't import: nothing under automatos-play changes; no new dependency; every new file <= 400 lines; check-changed-lines-eslint.js → 0 errors.
userStories.notes: Studio tokens are HSL triplets consumed as hsl(var(--x)) (tailwind.config.ts colors); the pre-wrapped aliases in the first .studio block of globals.css hold hsl(...) literals, which is why they are derived here. CSP already allows inline script and style (next.config.js script-src/style-src 'unsafe-inline'). Reference engine: prd259-spec/play-looks-ref/{css,prepaint,contrast}.ts.

userStories.title: The Style dropdown: the Skins group, Add a skin…, the base drives the studio class, the server sets data-skin, the single-tone lock, the fallback
userStories.description: As a workspace member, I want my workspace's installed skins in the Style dropdown next to Classic and Studio, switching instantly with no flash and without breaking Tone or any Studio layout (PRD-259 §4).
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/lib/ui-style.ts: the style cookie automatos-style also takes 'skin:<id>'; parseUiStyle accepts only 'classic', 'studio' or 'skin:' + SKIN_ID_PATTERN (anything else → the default); a second cookie UI_SKIN_BASE_COOKIE = 'automatos-skin-base' ('studio' | 'classic', default 'studio', parsed strictly) carries the skin's base so the server sets the class without a database call (decision K1); helpers skinIdOf(style) and baseOf(style, baseCookie). frontend/lib/__tests__/ui-style-skins.test.ts covers valid, tampered ('skin:"><script>', 'skin:../x') and missing cookies.

frontend/app/layout.tsx: <html> gets STUDIO_HTML_CLASS when the style is studio OR a skin whose base is studio, and data-skin="<id>" when a skin is chosen; <head> carries <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: SKIN_PREPAINT_SCRIPT }} /> (the constant only, nothing from the request). The attribute logic is a pure helper (e.g. htmlAttrsFor(styleCookie, baseCookie)) with a unit test: skin+studio → studio class + data-skin; skin+classic → no studio class + data-skin; tampered → default, no data-skin.

frontend/contexts/ui-style-context.tsx: isStudio is true when the BASE is studio, so the 12 files branching on isStudio (app/agents/page.tsx, app/assignments/page.tsx, app/chat/page.tsx, app/command-center/page.tsx, app/deliverables/page.tsx, app/playbooks/page.tsx, app/tools/page.tsx, components/documents/document-management.tsx, components/layout/main-layout.tsx, components/shared/filter-tabs.tsx, components/shared/page-header.tsx, components/shared/stats-bar.tsx) keep their layouts (a test: a studio-based skin → isStudio true, a classic-based one → false); setStyle for a skin writes both cookies, toggles the studio class from the base, sets data-skin, injects skinToCss into <style id="automatos-skin"> and caches it; choosing Classic or Studio removes data-skin, the style element and the cache entry.

frontend/components/ui/theme-toggle.tsx: under Style, Classic, Studio, then a 'Skins' label with the workspace's installed skins (GET /api/skins/installed through apiClient, in a small hook, e.g. hooks/use-installed-skins.ts), then 'Add a skin…' (a hidden file input accepting .autoskin and .zip → apiClient.post('/api/skins/import', formData) → the list refreshes and the new skin becomes active; a 400 shows the validator's messages in a toast). The new pieces are their own small components (e.g. components/ui/skin-menu-items.tsx); ThemeToggle stays a component under 150 lines. ('Browse skins' opens the Marketplace tab, which Wave 2 builds: S-006.)

Tone lock: while the active skin's tones is ['dark'], Light and System are disabled (greyed, aria-disabled) and the tone is Dark; ['light'] is the mirror (decision K4); leaving the skin restores the user's own tone. Prefer next-themes 0.2.1's forcedTheme on ThemeProvider (components/providers.tsx; it forces without overwriting the stored tone), else store and restore. A test: from a dark-only skin back to Studio restores a stored 'light'.

Fallback: when the active skin is not in the installed list, fails validateSkin, or skinToCss throws, the base style is applied (Studio if the base cookie is missing), the cookie is rewritten to the base, the cache entry is cleared, and a quiet notice shows once (an info toast: '<name, or The skin> isn't available here, so <Studio|Classic> is showing.'). A test per trigger.

frontend/components/__tests__/prd259-style-dropdown.test.tsx: the Skins group lists installed names; Add a skin… posts FormData through a mocked apiClient; the dark-only lock disables Light; the fallback notice.
No raw fetch('/api…'); the frontend route-contract check passes (the routes are in route-manifest.json from S-001 and S-003); check-changed-lines-eslint.js → 0 errors.
userStories.notes: UiStyleProvider sits INSIDE ThemeProvider in components/providers.tsx: lifting the active skin's tones so ThemeProvider can read them is the cleanest seam for forcedTheme. Tailwind 3.3.3 ignores darkMode: ['variant', …] (node_modules/tailwindcss/lib/corePlugins.js darkVariants knows only 'class' and 'media'; 'variant' arrived in 3.4.1), so all of them are dead today; ['class', '.dark'] gives the same :is(.dark &) selector (PRD-259 §7, decision 4). frontend/lib/__tests__/tailwind-dark-variant.test.ts: (a) the config's darkMode deep-equals ['class', '.dark']; (b) postcss + tailwindcss (both already dependencies) compile `<div class="dark:bg-background">` against the real config and the output contains ':is(.dark .dark\:bg-background)'.

docs/PRDS/PRD-259-DARK-VARIANT-AUDIT.md: a table with ONE row per dark: class use on the base, found by `git grep -noE "dark:[a-z!\[-][^ \"']*" <base> -- 'frontend/*.ts' 'frontend/*.tsx'` (133 uses in 22 files on origin/main f2be2abb0; the PRD's 135 in 24 came from a looser grep), columns: file:line (base) | class | verdict (keep / fix / remove) | why. This story fills every row of the components/chatbot/ files: markdown-components.tsx 24, sheet-artifact.tsx 24, text-artifact.tsx 18, message.tsx 13, artifact-viewer.tsx 9, artifact-metadata-panel.tsx 3, chat.tsx 2 (93 rows); the other files' rows are listed with verdict 'pending S-010b'.

Verdicts: keep = a token class that reads right in Classic Dark and Studio Dark; fix = a fixed palette colour (gray-*, slate-*, zinc-*, neutral-*, white, black, a hex) or a class that fights the token beneath it → the token class (text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, bg-muted, bg-card, border-border, …), or the dark: prefix dropped when the base class is already that token; remove = redundant (same as the base class) or dead (dark:prose-invert and every prose-* class are inert: @tailwindcss/typography is not installed, tailwind.config.ts plugins is tailwindcss-animate only). Every fix and remove is made in this story.

The code-shape trap: `Message` in components/chatbot/message.tsx (and the long functions in chat.tsx) are far over the function limit, and scripts/check-changed-lines-eslint.js fails on ANY touched line inside a function over the limit (the finding spans the whole function). Inside such a function only a pure line deletion is safe; a wrong use there that a pure deletion cannot fix gets the verdict 'fix — blocked by the code-shape ratchet (<function>, N lines)' and is listed in the DONE mark for the PR body. Never grow those functions.
cd frontend && node scripts/check-changed-lines-eslint.js origin/main → 0 errors; no orange-* class added (.eslintrc.json no-restricted-syntax).
